task_completion.description: The agent accesses the raw IAT data file at ~/pebl/data/iat_data.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., cat, head, pandas read) or a text editor showing the CSV content with columns: participant, block, trial, rt_ms, and correct.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies and excludes participants with >10% of trials under 300ms in blocks 3, 4, 6, and 7.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or terminal output showing the calculation of fast response percentages and the identification of 'sub-99' as a bot/excluded participant.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates D-scores using the Greenwald (2003) method (mean differences divided by pooled SD for blocks 3/6 and 4/7).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code snippets or intermediate logs showing the calculation of mean RTs, pooled standard deviations, and the final D-score formula being applied.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the analysis results to ~/pebl/analysis/iat_report.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command showing the creation of the file or a file explorer view showing the file exists in the specified directory.

task_completion.description: The final JSON contains the required fields: 'participants' list (with id, d_score, or excluded status) and 'group_mean_d_score'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'cat' or 'jq' command displaying the content of iat_report.json, showing 'sub-99' as excluded and a group mean D-score near 0.563.

integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the final group mean or the excluded participant ID without performing the analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's code or terminal history should show active processing of the CSV file rather than just echoing a pre-written JSON string.

integrity.description: The agent used appropriate tools (Python/Pandas/R) to perform the statistical calculations.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the execution of a script or interactive environment (like a Jupyter notebook or Python REPL) to process the data.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual file paths provided in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands or file dialogs referencing /home/ga/pebl/data/iat_data.csv and /home/ga/pebl/analysis/iat_report.json.
